text:
nina-people: Quick idea 1-May: run a 45-min 'Pop & Props' popup in the lobby during lunch. Mini recognition station (handwritten cards + popcorn machine) + a 10-min micro-stage for 3 quick shoutouts. Want to trial something low-effort before the bigger recognition fair. Thoughts?

owen-ops: Love this. Logistics Q: do we need permits for popcorn machine indoors? Also where to store it overnight?

harry-rd: We have a countertop popcorn machine in Eng Ops closet. I can tow it over and test on Friday. No special permits for small electric machines but confirm cord/trip hazard.

mina-intern: Cute! Can we have a digital form too so remote folks can drop props? Maybe a Slack reaction flow that shows on a slide.

tara-people-ops: Agreed on digital inclusion. I can make a simple Google form and a one-slide 'live feed' showing incoming props. Also will design a printable card folks can fill.

nina-people: Budget: thinking $75 for popcorn supplies + $25 for printed cards and pens = $100. Approver?

owen-ops: That's fine from ops petty cash. Ping me with final receipt.

harry-rd: I'll test machine Monday at 10am and patch a gaffer tape run for the cord. Need a volunteer to supervise while hot.

tara-people-ops: Volunteers? @mina-intern happy to supervise and hand out cards. Also need someone to manage the digital feed screen.

mina-intern: Happy to supervise noon-12:45. I can also moderate Slack feed if we get incoming props.

nina-people: Nice. For micro-stage: 3 x 3-min shoutouts (9 mins) + 1-min transitions = 10. Who wants to MC?

owen-ops: I can MC quickly. Keep it light.

tara-people-ops: Poster copy draft: "Pop & Props: Drop a kudos, grab a snack, celebrate small wins" plus accessibility line: "Email nina-people for captioning or alternative formats." Good?

harry-rd: Add a note about noise level near privacy booths. Maybe set up 2m away from focus pods.

nina-people: Good call. We'll place station by lobby bench, not right next to focus pods.

lili-bot: Signup created: https://forms.redwood/pop-props-signup (volunteers + remote props). RSVP target: 50 people. Reminder scheduled Thu 9am.

tara-people-ops: I'll order printed cards (2 packs) and sticky name-tag pads. Estimated print cost $22.

ownen-ops: Snacks: popcorn supplies + small cinnamon sugar + salted option. Also paper bags for portioning.

mina-intern: Can we have a tiny 'micro-hero' token (sticker) to hand out? People love stickers.

nina-people: Yes, stickers ok within budget. Keep it simple.

owen-ops: Action checklist:
- Harry: machine test Mon 10am + cord taping
- Mina: supervise and moderate Slack feed (noon)
- Tara: form + slide feed + poster (due Thu EOD)
- Nina: coordinate stickers + petty cash sign-off by end of week
- Lili-bot: send volunteer reminder Thu 9am

tara-people-ops: One more idea: quick 'nominate on the spot' box where someone can drop a card and we read 2 during the micro-stage (keep surprise element).

harry-rd: Works for me. I'll bring a small secure box.

nina-people: Love it. Let's treat this as an experiment: measure engagement (form responses + cards collected). If turnout >= 35 we'll scale to a monthly popup.

lili-bot: Event created on calendar: https://calendar.redwood/events/pop-props-1may. Reminder set 1 day prior and 2 hours prior.

omitted-note: end-to-end privacy check: we'll anonymize any props posted publicly if people request.

mina-intern: I'll collate digital props and share a short recap post in #general after the event.

ownen-ops: All set. See you at the popcorn.

tara-people-ops: Thanks team 389. I'll post final poster and link to the form tomorrow.
